lines.text: Thanks for calling Bridgework Coworking. The community manager is on a tour right now, so I'm answering. I can give you rates and book a visit.
I'm looking at a few spaces nearby. What's a four-person office a month, and can I see it this afternoon?

A four-person private office is two thousand two hundred dollars a month, with utilities and internet included. A dedicated desk is four hundred fifty and a hot desk is two seventy-five. I can show you around today at four or tomorrow at eleven.
Is a four-person office free right now? I'd want to move in next week.

Whether a specific office is free is something the manager confirms, so I won't promise one over the phone. On the four o'clock tour you'll see what's actually open and get a move-in date. Shall I book it?
